newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangzhou ITIC 364-day FRCD raised to US$60 mln.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou ITIC 364-day FRCD raised to US$60 mln.

text.p: Guangzhou International Trust and Investment Corp's floating rate certificates of deposit issue has been increased to US$60 million from US$40 million due to oversubscription, said arranger Banque Francaise du Commerce Exterieur.
The 364-day certificates were priced at par to float at 30 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 115 basis points.
Arrangers are Bankgesellschaft Berlin, Banque Francaise du Commerce Exterieur, Hana Bank and Kookmin Bank.
Fourteen international banks in addition to the arrangers joined the syndication.
Signing is set for April 22 in Hong Kong. The payment date is on May 13.
